core_frameworks: ANNOUNCEMENT — Bold event reveal with date, time, location, and key details front and center
COUNTDOWN — Urgency-driven countdown timer design building excitement as event approaches
SAVE_THE_DATE — Elegant date reservation visual that makes audiences mark their calendars
LAUNCH_EVENT — Product or collection drop with exclusive hype and limited-time excitement
FLASH_SALE — Time-limited promotional event with bold urgency and deal-focused design
SEASONAL — Holiday, seasonal, or themed event tied to calendar moments and cultural events
WEBINAR_LIVE — Virtual event, live stream, or webinar promotion with speaker and topic focus
RSVP_INVITE — Formal invitation with RSVP action driving confirmed attendance

tiktok.creative_rules: Exciting event teaser energy. Bold text reveals. Countdown urgency. Quick date/time flash. Hype-building content native to TikTok. Full-screen vertical 9:16. Hook in first 0.5 seconds.

meta.creative_rules: Bold event announcement with date/time prominent. Professional event marketing quality. Register/RSVP CTA button. Share-worthy design that drives event awareness. Clean bold typography. 4:5 portrait for maximum feed visibility.

youtube.creative_rules: Event banner or countdown thumbnail quality. Speaker headshots for webinars. Bold date overlay. High-contrast event branding. Subscribe/notification bell integration. 16:9 landscape.

pinterest.creative_rules: Aspirational event visual. Seasonal themed design. Save-worthy pin that inspires attendance. Beautiful typography with event details. 2:3 vertical pin format.

instagram.creative_rules: Eye-catching event graphic that stops the scroll. Date/time bold and unmissable. Feed-cohesive event branding. Swipe-for-details carousels. Story-ready countdown. 4:5 portrait or 1:1 square.

facebook.creative_rules: Event banner quality for Facebook Events. Share-worthy announcement design. RSVP/Interested CTA integration. Community-driven event feel. 4:5 portrait or 16:9 banner.

x.creative_rules: Bold announcement graphic optimized for timeline. Date and key details immediately visible. High-contrast event branding. Sharp professional design. 16:9 landscape for maximum tweet preview.

visual_direction.lighting: soft elegant studio, warm glow, f/4 for luxe softness
